findings.title: A truthful title becomes tested interpretive credit
findings.claim: The title applied to Joseph makes the requested interpretation legible as an answer entrusted to demonstrated reliability: the prior word has acquired weight through correspondence with events and benefit.
findings.mechanism: The focus title at 12:46:3:2 meets the request at 12:46:4:1. The supplied truth-and-action, truth-and-confirmation, realized-vision, and interpretive-teaching connections turn the title from an address into the credibility condition under which the answer is sought.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the address as a public appeal to a tested interpreter, not merely as a courteous intensifier before a question.
findings.containment: The ordinary personal title and request remain the reading floor. The physical straightness facet is retained only as an explicitly analogical pressure, not as a literal physical description; the personal reliability facet carries the direct title sense. Contrary public speech and unsupported claims remain a boundary on treating any public word as proof.

epistemic.reason: The retained core is stated by the citable trusted cross-run finding. The contextual connection rows supply exact Arabic but no target morphology, and the physical-solid facet is therefore marked analogical and bounded.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Nitelik, biçim bakımından düz veya düzgün olmayı da anlatabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The personal title al-siddiq is the focus form through which Joseph's quality is presented.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 49:15 and 39:33 connection evidence joins truthfulness to congruent commitment, carried truth, and confirmation.
branch_activations.activation: The branch's straight and sound quality meets those enacted-truth contexts as an analogy, making the requested answer feel firm and credit-bearing rather than merely verbal.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Joseph's interpretive reply is approached with the force of tested solidity.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an analogical pressure, not a claim that Joseph is literally a physical object; direct personal reliability belongs to the neighboring B003 activation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan nitelemesinde iyilik, erdem, sağlam karakter ve güvenilirlik öne çıkar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus title names Joseph as a person whose character is being relied upon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied contexts join truth to sustained costly conduct and carried confirmation, while 12:16 and 12:17 provide contrary cases in which visible speech or an unsupported claim alone does not establish truth.
branch_activations.activation: The personal reliability facet meets both enacted confirmation and the contrary speech-only backdrop, so the title functions as a tested character credential before the request is made.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The requested interpretation is entrusted to a person whose goodness and reliability have become evidentially usable.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not reduce the title to a moral verdict or make every claim by a public speaker true; its force is the bounded reliability relevant to this request.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir tahminin veya beklentinin doğru çıkması da gerçekleşme yoluyla doğrulamadır.
branch_activations.carrier: The title is carried by the same focus form that precedes the request for interpretation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 12:100 and 48:27 connections describe visions or expectations becoming true through their realized outcomes.
branch_activations.activation: When realized outcome meets the title before the new request, the title carries the memory of confirmation into the next interpretation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The answer is sought as a further interpretation under a reputation formed by fulfilled correspondence.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains a confirmation pressure; it does not claim that every future interpretation is already fulfilled or that the title replaces the dream's ordinary address.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişinin gördüğü düşü ona yorumlamak, açıklayıcı cevap verme düzeninin özel bir uzantısıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative aftina directly asks Joseph to give an explanatory answer about the dream inventory.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 12:6 and 37:149 connections place Joseph's interpretive teaching and authoritative ruling-seeking in a wider context.
branch_activations.activation: The explanatory-answer facet meets the tested title, so the request becomes an appeal to an established interpretive authority whose reply can bear public use.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dream question is a request for a warranted ruling from a trusted interpreter, not an invitation to free association.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains the special dream-interpretation extension of answer-giving; it does not claim a general legal ruling beyond this scene.

findings.title: Interpretation becomes a relay into public knowledge
findings.claim: The requested interpretation is framed as knowledge that returns to the people and can enter shared practice, rather than remaining private expertise in Joseph.
findings.mechanism: The first-person return verb at 12:46:18:1 supplies movement toward an audience, while the closing knowing verb at 12:46:22:1 supplies the intended public result. The supplied return-and-report and public-witnessing connections make those two focus acts one relay.
findings.reader_payoff: The return clause is heard as the delivery stage of the interpretation itself: the answer moves outward until the people can know and use it.
findings.containment: The ordinary scene remains a messenger returning to people after asking Joseph for a dream interpretation. The wider evidence adds public circulation and practical use without asserting a surah-wide channel or making every return an information transfer.

epistemic.reason: The citable trusted cross-run finding explicitly states the public relay. Connection rows supply exact target Arabic for return, report, and public witnessing, while their missing target morphology limits the branch-level application.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, başladığı yere ya da daha önce bulunduğu duruma geri döner.
branch_activations.carrier: The first-person imperfect return verb places the messenger's movement toward the people inside the focus ayah.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:64 and 12:63 contexts join return with report and a later practical return-to-an-audience sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The ordinary movement back meets the wider report pattern, making return the transport stage by which the requested interpretation leaves the exchange.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The messenger's return is part of the answer's route into a receiving public.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch preserves ordinary return of the messenger; it does not claim that the verb alone means transmitting knowledge or that every later return is identical.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The closing imperfect knowing verb names the people as the intended recipients of understanding.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:64 and 21:61 contexts connect report or public presentation with an audience's knowing or witnessing.
branch_activations.activation: The learning outcome meets the return movement, so public knowledge is not an afterthought but the purpose that completes the relay.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Joseph's interpretation is projected toward shared understanding and actionable public knowledge.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus promises a hoped-for public knowing; it does not guarantee that every recipient accepts or acts on the answer, and it does not state a surah-wide information system.
